description: For a multi_speaker localize_video job waiting at WaitingSpeakerVoices: give each speaker (key = speaker label from get_localization_status, e.g. "0") a voice token for that job's language, then dubbing continues. Speakers you leave out use the job's main voice. Pick voices that fit each character (gender, age, tone from the sample lines) and confirm with the user. translate_first = true continues to translation and pauses again with translated sample lines. Can also be called earlier, while the job is still transcribing or translating.

job_guid.description: job_guid of one language from localize_video.

translate_first.description: Translate first and choose voices after (pauses again).

name: set_speaker_voices
